rows.source_ko: 농촌진흥청 (혁신행정법무담당관), 063-238-0448
rows.text_en: Rural Development Administration ( Innovation Administration & Legal Affairs Division ), 063-238-0448

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 농촌진흥청과 그 소속기관에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 기획조정관ㆍ국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「농촌진흥청과 그 소속기관 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Organization of the Rural Development Administration and Its Affiliated Agencies” and matters necessary for its implementation, such as the ranks and staffing quotas for auxiliary and advisory agencies established within the Rural Development Administration and its affiliated agencies, the establishment of auxiliary agencies and advisory agencies equivalent thereto placed under the Director of Planning and Coordination and the Director-General pursuant to Article 2, Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the “Government Organization Act,” and the division of duties.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 농촌진흥청
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Rural Development Administration

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 24.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Vice Administrator) The Vice Administrator shall be appointed from among general civil servants, agricultural research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2011. 2. 17., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) The Spokesperson shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary for Science and Technology, Secretary, Research Officer for Industry, Research Officer for Agriculture, Research Officer for Veterinary Medicine, Research Officer for Public Health, Research Officer for Environment, or Rural Extension Officers. <Amended Feb. 17, 2011; Jul. 1, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Director of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, public health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관ㆍ혁신행정법무담당관ㆍ지식정보담당관ㆍ고객지원담당관 및 농업지능데이터팀을 두며, 각 담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 농업지능데이터팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 9. 24., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be the Planning and Finance Officer, the Innovation Administration and Legal Affairs Officer, the Knowledge Information Officer, the Customer Support Officer, and the Agricultural Intelligent Data Team. Each Officer shall be appointed as a Deputy Director, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, Health Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer, and the Head of the Agricultural Intelligent Data Team shall be appointed as a Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Agricultural Officer, Computer Science Officer, Administrative Officer, Industrial Research Officer, Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, Health Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer. <Amended Sep. 24, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023; Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 고객지원담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <신설 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Customer Support Officer assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Agricultural Intelligent Data Team assists the Director of Planning and Coordination with respect to the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 19, 2026>

rows.text_en: 2. Establishment and support of plans for the collection, sharing, and utilization of research data within the agency

rows.source_ko: 제5조(감사담당관) 감사담당관은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2011. 2. 17., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Audit Officer) The Audit Officer shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Research Officer of Industry, Research Officer of Agriculture, Research Officer of Veterinary Medicine, Research Officer of Public Health, Research Officer of Environment, or Rural Extension Officers. <Amended Feb. 17, 2011; Jul. 1, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023>
Article 5-2 Deleted <Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2011. 2. 17., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, Public Health Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer. <Amended Feb. 17, 2011; Jul. 1, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(연구정책국) ① 연구정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Research Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Research Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, public health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers, provided that the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 연구정책국에 연구정책과ㆍ연구개발과ㆍ연구관리과ㆍ농자재산업과ㆍ스마트농업팀 및 바이오푸드테크팀을 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 스마트농업팀장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ전산사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 바이오푸드테크팀장은 농업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2017. 11. 1., 2019. 10. 18., 2021. 7. 1., 2022. 9. 30., 2023. 6. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Research Policy Bureau shall have the Research Policy Division, Research and Development Division, Research Management Division, Agricultural Materials Industry Division, Smart Agriculture Team, and Biofood Tech Team. Each division head shall be appointed as a deputy director, science and technology secretary, secretary, industrial research officer, agricultural research officer, veterinary research officer, health research officer, environmental research officer, or rural extension officer; the head of the Smart Agriculture Team shall be appointed as a science and technology secretary, secretary, agricultural officer, computer officer, administrative officer, industrial research officer, agricultural research officer, veterinary research officer, health research officer, environmental research officer, or rural extension officer; and the head of the Biofood Tech Team shall be appointed as an agricultural research officer. <Amended Nov. 1, 2017; Oct. 18, 2019; Jul. 1, 2021; Sep. 30, 2022; Jun. 23, 2023; Aug. 30, 2023; Dec. 19, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

③ The Head of the Research Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Sep. 1, 2009; June 1, 2012; March 23, 2013; October 1, 2013; January 6, 2015; October 18, 2019; May 23, 2022; Sep. 30, 2022>

rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of mid-to-long-term and implementation plans for agricultural science and technology research and development projects

rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of Guidelines and Improvement of Systems Related to Agricultural Science and Technology Research and Development Projects

rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of a system for cooperation in agricultural science and technology R&D projects and support

rows.source_ko: 제11조(국립농업과학원) ① 국립농업과학원에 기획조정과ㆍ운영지원과ㆍ기술지원과 및 농촌환경안전과를 두며, 각 과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2015. 1. 6., 2020. 6. 25., 2021. 2. 25., 2021. 7. 1., 2022. 5. 23., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (National Institute of Agricultural Sciences) ① The National Institute of Agricultural Sciences shall have the Planning and Coordination Division, the Operational Support Division, the Technical Support Division, and the Rural Environment and Safety Division; the heads of each Division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Agricultural Research Officers, or Rural Extension Officers. <Amended June 1, 2012; January 6, 2015; June 25, 2020; February 25, 2021; July 1, 2021; May 23, 2022; August 30, 2023; February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시험연구사업에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and evaluation of plans for test and research projects

rows.source_ko: 2. 시험연구사업 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Test and Research Projects

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산의 편성 및 집행의 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Coordination of budget formulation and execution

rows.source_ko: 4. 성과관리 및 직무성과계약 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of Performance Management and Job Performance Contract Systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제협력 연구 등 대외협력업무의 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and coordination of external cooperation affairs, including international cooperation research

rows.source_ko: 6. 연구성과 및 기관 홍보 계획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Planning and Coordination of Research Achievements and Institutional Promotion

rows.source_ko: 7. 정보화 사업 총괄 및 전산실 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of IT projects and operation of the computer center

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 원내 다른 부 및 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments and divisions within the Institute

rows.source_ko: ③ 운영지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of Operations Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인사ㆍ문서ㆍ보안 및 관인관수
rows.text_en: 1. Personnel, Documents, Security, and Management of Official Seals

rows.source_ko: 2. 훈령ㆍ예규ㆍ지침안의 입안
rows.text_en: 2. Drafting of Directives, Circulars, and Guidelines

rows.source_ko: 3. 급여ㆍ회계ㆍ결산 및 용도
rows.text_en: 3. Payroll, Accounting, Settlement, and Usage

rows.source_ko: 4. 국유재산 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of state-owned property and goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 연구개발ㆍ보급에 관한 행정지원
rows.text_en: 5. Other administrative support regarding research and development and dissemination
④ The Head of the Technical Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established June 1, 2012; Feb. 25, 2021; Dec. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농기계 등 관련 신기술 조기 보급ㆍ지원 시스템 구축 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and operation of a system for the early dissemination and support of new technologies related to agricultural machinery, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 농기계 등 관련 신기술의 농가실증(農家實證)및 시범사업 추진
rows.text_en: 2. Promotion of farm demonstrations and pilot projects for new technologies related to agricultural machinery, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 현장애로기술 발굴 및 사업화 추진
rows.text_en: 3. Identification of on-site technical challenges and promotion of commercialization

rows.source_ko: 4. 개발기술의 산업화 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for the industrialization of developed technologies

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 농촌환경안전과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Rural Environment and Safety Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농촌 환경자원의 발굴ㆍ보전ㆍ개발 및 산업화에 관한 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Technology development regarding the discovery, conservation, development, and industrialization of rural environmental resources

rows.source_ko: 2. 농촌의 공익적 기능평가 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. A Study on the Evaluation and Utilization of Public Interest Functions in Rural Areas

rows.source_ko: 3. 농업ㆍ농촌 전통지식ㆍ기술의 발굴 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Discovery and Utilization of Traditional Knowledge and Technology in Agriculture and Rural Areas

rows.source_ko: 4. 농촌관광 활성화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. A Study on the Promotion of Rural Tourism

rows.source_ko: 5. 귀농ㆍ귀촌 및 정주지원 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Support for Returning to Farming, Returning to Rural Areas, and Settlement

rows.source_ko: 6. 농촌 환경자원의 산업적 이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Industrial Utilization of Rural Environmental Resources

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업인 복지실태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. A Study on the Welfare Status of Farmers

rows.source_ko: 8. 농작업 편이장비 및 안전 증진 기술의 개발
rows.text_en: 8. Development of agricultural work convenience equipment and safety enhancement technologies

rows.source_ko: 9. 농업인 안전보건 통계의 조사ㆍ분석 및 재해 원인 구명 연구
rows.text_en: 9. Survey and Analysis of Agricultural Worker Safety and Health Statistics and Research on Identifying the Causes of Accidents

rows.source_ko: 10. 농작업 유해ㆍ위험요인의 평가 및 저감기술ㆍ예방관리시스템 개발
rows.text_en: 10. Assessment of Hazardous and Risky Factors in Agricultural Work and Development of Mitigation Technologies and Preventive Management Systems

rows.source_ko: 11. 농업인의 건강증진 및 안전인식 제고 등을 위한 연구
rows.text_en: 11. Research for the health promotion and enhancement of safety awareness among farmers

rows.source_ko: 제12조(농업환경부) ① 농업환경부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2017. 11. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Ministry of Agriculture and Environment) ① The Minister of Agriculture and Environment shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Nov. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 농업환경부에 기후변화대응과ㆍ토양물환경과 및 재생유기농업과를 두며, 기후변화대응과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ기상연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 환경연구관으로, 토양물환경과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 환경연구관으로, 재생유기농업과장은 농업연구관 또는 환경연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Ministry of Agriculture, Environment and Agriculture shall establish the Climate Change Response Division, the Soil and Water Environment Division, and the Regenerative Organic Agriculture Division. The Head of the Climate Change Response Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Research Officer for Agriculture, Research Officer for Meteorology, Research Officer for Health, or Research Officer for Environment; the Head of the Soil and Water Environment Division shall be appointed as a Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Research Officer for Agriculture, or Research Officer for Environment; and the Head of the Regenerative Organic Agriculture Division shall be appointed as a Research Officer for Agriculture or Research Officer for Environment. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기후변화대응과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Climate Change Response Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업기상 정보 분석 및 활용체계 구축
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of an Agricultural Weather Information Analysis and Utilization System

rows.source_ko: 2. 농업분야 기후변화 실태조사 및 영향ㆍ취약성 평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Status of Climate Change and Impact and Vulnerability Assessment in the Agricultural Sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 농업부문 온실가스 감축 등 기후변화 대응기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of climate change response technologies, including greenhouse gas reduction in the agricultural sector

rows.source_ko: 4. 작물 환경반응 생리 및 재해경감에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Physiology of Crop Environmental Responses and Disaster Mitigation

rows.source_ko: 5. 농업환경오염 영향평가 및 개선에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Impact Assessment and Improvement of Agricultural Environmental Pollution

rows.source_ko: 6. 농업부문 저탄소 녹색성장 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of Low-Carbon Green Growth Technologies in the Agricultural Sector

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업환경 정보 이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on the Use of Agricultural Environmental Information

rows.source_ko: ④ 토양물환경과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Soil, Water, and Environment Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국내외 토양 정밀조사, 토양분류 및 정보이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on domestic and international soil detailed surveys, soil classification, and information utilization

rows.source_ko: 2. 농경지 토양보전 및 물 관리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Soil Conservation and Water Management in Agricultural Land

rows.source_ko: 3. 농경지 토양의 물리ㆍ화학적 특성 분석 및 시비ㆍ비옥도 관리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Analysis of Physical and Chemical Characteristics of Agricultural Soil and Management of Fertilization and Fertility

rows.source_ko: 4. 작물 양분관리 및 영양생리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Crop Nutrient Management and Nutritional Physiology
⑤ The Head of the Regenerative Organic Agriculture Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established June 1, 2012; November 1, 2017; October 7, 2020; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 친환경ㆍ유기 농업 정책지원 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on Policy Support for Eco-friendly and Organic Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 2. 친환경ㆍ유기 농업 재배 기준설정 및 실용화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Establishment of Cultivation Standards and Practical Application of Eco-friendly and Organic Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 3. 친환경ㆍ유기 농산물 생산 및 소비 기반기술에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Basic Technologies for the Production and Consumption of Eco-friendly and Organic Agricultural Products

rows.source_ko: 4. 유기농업자재 및 생물제제(製劑)의 실용화기술 개발과 안전성 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Commercialization Technology and Safety Research for Organic Agricultural Materials and Biological Preparations

rows.source_ko: 5. 친환경ㆍ유기 농업의 표준영농기술에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Standard Farming Techniques for Eco-friendly and Organic Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 6. 유기성 자원의 농업적 이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Agricultural Use of Organic Resources

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업생태계 건전성 유지ㆍ보전 및 유용 생태자원이용 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on Maintaining and Conserving the Health of Agricultural Ecosystems and Utilizing Useful Ecological Resources
⑥ Deleted <February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(농업생물부) ① 농업생물부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2017. 11. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Department of Agriculture and Biology) ① The Head of the Department of Agriculture and Biology shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, public health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Nov. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 농업생물부에 농업미생물과ㆍ식물소재바이오공학과ㆍ산업곤충과 및 양봉과를 두며, 농업미생물과장은 농업연구관으로, 식물소재바이오공학과장은 농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 산업곤충과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 양봉과장은 농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Agriculture and Biology shall have the Division of Agricultural Microbiology, the Division of Plant Materials and Bioengineering, the Division of Industrial Entomology, and the Division of Apiculture. The Head of the Division of Agricultural Microbiology shall be appointed as an Agricultural Research Officer; the Head of the Division of Plant Materials and Bioengineering as an Agricultural Research Officer or a Health Research Officer; the Head of the Division of Industrial Entomology as a Secretary for Science and Technology, an Agricultural Research Officer, or a Health Research Officer; and the Head of the Division of Apiculture as an Agricultural Research Officer or a Health Research Officer. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 농업미생물과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Agricultural Microbiology Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유용미생물의 분류 및 동정(同定)
rows.text_en: 1. Classification and Identification of Useful Microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 2. 유용미생물 탐색, 선발 및 기능 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the discovery, selection, and functional utilization of useful microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 3. 유용미생물의 생리생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the physiological ecology of beneficial microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 4. 유용미생물을 이용한 고부가가치 신소재 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of High Value-Added New Materials Using Beneficial Microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 5. 유용미생물의 산업화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the industrialization of useful microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 6. 유해미생물의 분류ㆍ동정ㆍ진단ㆍ분석 및 생리생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the classification, identification, diagnosis, analysis, and physiological ecology of harmful microorganisms

rows.source_ko: 7. 농산물 중 유해미생물의 안전관리ㆍ제어 및 국제기준에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on the Safety Management, Control, and International Standards of Harmful Microorganisms in Agricultural Products

rows.source_ko: ④ 식물소재바이오공학과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Department of Plant Materials and Bioengineering shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유용소재 발굴ㆍ생산을 위한 농생명정보 탐색 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the Exploration and Utilization of Agro-bioinformatics for the Discovery and Production of Useful Materials

rows.source_ko: 2. 대사산물 등 유용소재 생산 농생명자원의 탐색ㆍ발굴 및 소재화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the exploration, discovery, and commercialization of agrobiological resources for the production of useful materials, such as metabolites

rows.source_ko: 3. 생명공학 활용 유용소재 생산에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the production of useful materials using biotechnology

rows.source_ko: 4. 식물체의 고품질 기능성분 강화 유전자 및 소재 개발 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of Genes and Materials for Enhancing High-Quality Functional Components in Plants

rows.source_ko: 5. 유용소재 생산을 위한 식물체의 유전, 생리 및 환경에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the genetics, physiology, and environment of plants for the production of useful materials

rows.source_ko: 6. 첨단생명공학기술 활용 고부가가치 신소재 개발, 생산 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Development, Production, and Utilization of High Value-Added New Materials Using Advanced Biotechnology

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 산업곤충과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Industrial Insect Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 유용곤충(벌류는 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 탐색ㆍ분류ㆍ동정 및 정밀진단기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of detection, classification, identification, and precision diagnostic technologies for useful insects (excluding bees; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 유용곤충의 생리생태 및 병리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Physiological Ecology and Pathology of Useful Insects

rows.source_ko: 3. 유용곤충의 유전정보 해석 및 유용물질 생산ㆍ이용에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the interpretation of genetic information of useful insects and the production and utilization of useful substances

rows.source_ko: 4. 유용곤충 및 뽕나무의 유전자원 보존, 사육ㆍ재배기술 및 품종육성 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the conservation of genetic resources, rearing and cultivation techniques, and variety breeding of useful insects and mulberry trees

rows.source_ko: 5. 곤충(벌류는 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 자원의 대량 사육체계 확립에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the establishment of a mass rearing system for insect resources (excluding bees; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 6. 곤충을 이용한 고부가가치 신소재 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of high value-added new materials using insects

rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Conservation of Honeybee Genetic Resources and Breeding

rows.source_ko: 3. 꿀벌의 사육 및 안정생산기술 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Rearing and Development of Stable Production Technologies for Honeybees

rows.source_ko: 4. 꿀벌의 병해충 관리기술 개발 연구

rows.source_ko: 제14조(농산물안전성부) ① 농산물안전성부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Ministry of Agricultural Product Safety) ① The Minister of Agricultural Product Safety shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 농산물안전성부에 식물병방제과ㆍ해충잡초방제과ㆍ잔류화학평가과 및 독성위해평가과를 두며, 식물병방제과장은 농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 해충잡초방제과장은 농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 잔류화학평가과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 환경연구관으로, 독성위해평가과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Agricultural Product Safety shall have the Plant Disease Control Division, the Pest and Weed Control Division, the Residual Chemical Assessment Division, and the Toxicity Risk Assessment Division; the head of the Plant Disease Control Division shall be an agricultural research officer or a health research officer; the head of the Pest and Weed Control Division shall be an agricultural research officer, a veterinary research officer, a health research officer, an environmental research officer, or a rural extension officer; the head of the Residual Chemical Assessment Division shall be a science and technology secretary, an agricultural research officer, a veterinary research officer, a health research officer, or an environmental research officer; and the head of the Toxicity Risk Assessment Division shall be a science and technology secretary, a secretary, an agricultural research officer, a veterinary research officer, a health research officer, an environmental research officer, or a rural extension officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 식물병방제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Plant Disease Control Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농작물 병의 분류ㆍ동정 및 진단기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of Classification, Identification, and Diagnostic Technologies for Crop Diseases

rows.source_ko: 2. 농작물 병의 생리생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Physiological Ecology of Crop Diseases

rows.source_ko: 3. 농작물 병 발생조사, 예찰기술 개발 및 피해해석에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on crop disease occurrence surveys, development of forecasting technologies, and damage analysis

rows.source_ko: 4. 농작물 병 종합관리 기반기술 및 모형 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of Basic Technologies and Models for Integrated Crop Disease Management

rows.source_ko: 5. 친환경ㆍ유기 농업을 활용한 농작물 병 방제기술 개발 및 실용화 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Development and Commercialization of Crop Disease Control Technology Utilizing Eco-friendly and Organic Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 6. 농작물 곰팡이 독소의 진단ㆍ제어에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Diagnosis and Control of Crop Mycotoxins

rows.source_ko: ④ 해충잡초방제과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Pest and Weed Control Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농작물 해충 및 잡초의 분류ㆍ동정 및 진단기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of classification, identification, and diagnostic technologies for crop pests and weeds

rows.source_ko: 2. 농작물 해충 및 잡초의 생리생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the physiological ecology of crop pests and weeds

rows.source_ko: 3. 농작물 해충 및 잡초 발생조사, 예찰기술 개발 및 피해해석에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the occurrence survey of crop pests and weeds, development of forecasting techniques, and damage analysis

rows.source_ko: 4. 농작물 해충 및 잡초 종합관리 기반기술 및 모형 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of Basic Technologies and Models for Integrated Management of Crop Pests and Weeds

rows.source_ko: 5. 친환경ㆍ유기 농업을 활용한 해충ㆍ잡초 방제기술 개발 및 실용화 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Development and Commercialization of Pest and Weed Control Technologies Using Eco-friendly and Organic Agriculture

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 잔류화학평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Residual Chemical Evaluation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농산물 오염 유해물질별 분석기술 개발 및 오염원 구명 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on Development of Analytical Technologies for Hazardous Substances Contaminating Agricultural Products and Identification of Pollution Sources

rows.source_ko: 2. 안전농산물 생산기술 개발 및 평가기법 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Development of Safe Agricultural Product Production Technologies and Evaluation Techniques

rows.source_ko: 3. 국제기구 관리 대상 유해물질의 안전관리 기준설정 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Establishing Safety Management Standards for Hazardous Substances Managed by International Organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. 농약의 잔류 시험기준과 방법 설정 및 등록평가 기법 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment of Pesticide Residue Testing Standards and Methods and Development of Registration Evaluation Techniques

rows.source_ko: 5. 등록신청 농약의 작물 및 환경 잔류성, 이화학성 평가
rows.text_en: 5. Evaluation of crop and environmental persistence and physicochemical properties of the pesticide applied for registration

rows.source_ko: 6. 농약의 안전사용기준 및 잔류허용기준 설정 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on Establishing Safe Use Standards and Tolerable Residue Limits for Pesticides

rows.source_ko: 7. 농약원제ㆍ제품의 분석법 개발 및 품질관리에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on the Development of Analytical Methods and Quality Control for Pesticide Active Ingredients and Products

rows.source_ko: 8. 비료의 품질ㆍ안전성 평가와 평가기준설정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Matters concerning the evaluation of the quality and safety of fertilizers and the establishment of evaluation standards

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 독성위해평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Toxicology Risk Assessment Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 농약의 약효ㆍ약해ㆍ독성시험 기준과 방법 설정 및 등록평가 기법 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of Standards and Methods for Testing Pesticide Efficacy, Phytotoxicity, and Toxicity, and Development of Registration Evaluation Techniques

rows.source_ko: 2. 등록신청 농약의 약효ㆍ약해ㆍ독성 평가
rows.text_en: 2. Evaluation of Efficacy, Phytotoxicity, and Toxicity of the Pesticide for Registration

rows.source_ko: 3. 농약ㆍ유해물질의 사람ㆍ가축 및 환경에 대한 안전성 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the safety of pesticides and hazardous substances for humans, livestock, and the environment

rows.source_ko: 4. 농약의 생물활성 및 위해성 평가
rows.text_en: 4. Biological Activity and Risk Assessment of Pesticides

rows.source_ko: 5. 유기농업자재의 독성 평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the toxicity assessment of organic agricultural materials
[Wholly Amended Feb. 25, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(농업공학부) ① 농업공학부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2012. 6. 1., 2017. 11. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Division of Agricultural Engineering) ① The Head of the Division of Agricultural Engineering shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, public health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Jun. 1, 2012; Nov. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 농업공학부에 스마트팜개발과ㆍ밭농업기계과ㆍ농업로봇과ㆍ수확후관리공학과 및 농업위성센터를 두며, 스마트팜개발과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ공업연구관 또는 농업연구관으로, 밭농업기계과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 농업로봇과장은 공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 시설연구관으로, 수확후관리공학과장은 공업연구관 또는 농업연구관으로, 농업위성센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2015. 11. 30., 2016. 5. 10., 2016. 11. 1., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 2. 28., 2023. 8. 30., 2024. 5. 14., 2025. 2. 25., 2026. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Agricultural Engineering shall have the Smart Farm Development Division, the Field Crop Machinery Division, the Agricultural Robotics Division, the Post-Harvest Management Engineering Division, and the Agricultural Satellite Center. The head of the Smart Farm Development Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, an Industrial Research Officer, or an Agricultural Research Officer; the head of the Field Crop Machinery Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, a Secretary, an Industrial Research Officer, an Agricultural Research Officer, or a Rural Extension Officer; the head of the Agricultural Robotics Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Research Officer, an Agricultural Research Officer, or a Facilities Research Officer; the head of the Post-Harvest Management Engineering Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Research Officer or an Agricultural Research Officer; and the head of the Agricultural Satellite Center shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, a Secretary, an Agricultural Research Officer, a Veterinary Research Officer, a Health Research Officer, an Environmental Research Officer, or a Rural Extension Officer. <Amended June 1, 2012; Nov 30, 2015; May 10, 2016; Nov 1, 2016; July 1, 2021; Feb 28, 2023; Aug 30, 2023; May 14, 2024; Feb 25, 2025; May 28, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 스마트팜개발과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Smart Farm Development Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 2. 스마트팜 종합데이터 수집 및 활용기술 연구

rows.source_ko: 3. 수직농장 및 동물 생산 공정 자동화 시스템 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Vertical Farms and Animal Production Process Automation Systems

rows.source_ko: 4. 스마트팜 최적 환경관리 및 신ㆍ재생에너지 활용 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Optimal Environmental Management and New & Renewable Energy Utilization in Smart Farms

rows.source_ko: 5. 스마트팜 표준화 기반기술 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Basic Technologies for Smart Farm Standardization

rows.source_ko: ④ 밭농업기계과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Field Crop Machinery Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 서류ㆍ잡곡류ㆍ유지작물 등 밭작물 생산 기계화 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the Mechanization of Field Crops Production, Including Root Crops, Grains, and Oilseeds

rows.source_ko: 2. 무ㆍ배추ㆍ고추ㆍ마늘ㆍ양파 등 원예작물 생산 기계화 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Mechanization of Horticultural Crop Production, Including Radishes, Napa Cabbage, Chili Peppers, Garlic, and Onions

rows.source_ko: 5. 생산기반 등의 농업재해 예방 및 안전성ㆍ내구성 향상 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the prevention of agricultural disasters and improvement of safety and durability of production infrastructure, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 농업기계의 안전성ㆍ환경위해성 등에 대한 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 6. Testing and research on the safety and environmental risks of agricultural machinery

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업기계 표준화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on the Standardization of Agricultural Machinery

rows.source_ko: 8. 농작물 생산성 향상을 위한 농지 범용화 기계기술 연구
rows.text_en: 8. Research on Machinery Technology for Generalization of Farmland to Improve Crop Productivity

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 농업로봇과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농작업 무인화를 위한 농업로봇 기술 연구

rows.source_ko: 1. 농산물 산지처리 및 위해요소 제거시스템 연구

rows.source_ko: 2. 농산물 비파괴 품질판정 및 선별시스템 연구

rows.source_ko: 3. 농산물 안전성 판정 및 유해물질 신속검출 기계기술 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Mechanical Technology for Agricultural Product Safety Assessment and Rapid Detection of Hazardous Substances

rows.source_ko: 4. 농산물 고품질 유지 저장 및 유통관리 기계시스템 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Mechanical Systems for Maintaining High Quality of Agricultural Products, Storage, and Distribution Management

rows.source_ko: 5. 농산물 가공 및 공정 자동화 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Agricultural Product Processing and Process Automation

rows.source_ko: 6. 농산물 산지처리ㆍ저장ㆍ선별ㆍ유통ㆍ가공 시설의 효율화 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Efficiency of On-Site Processing, Storage, Sorting, Distribution, and Processing Facilities for Agricultural Products

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 농업위성센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2024. 5. 14.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업위성 관측망 구축ㆍ운영ㆍ자료수신 및 촬영계획 관리

rows.text_en: 2. Operation, maintenance, and improvement of agricultural satellite center facilities and equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. 농업위성 농업관측정보의 처리ㆍ저장ㆍ관리 및 배포
rows.text_en: 3. Processing, storage, management, and distribution of agricultural observation information from agricultural satellites

rows.source_ko: 4. 농업위성 관측자료 영상 표준화 업무 및 검정ㆍ보정 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Standardization of Agricultural Satellite Observation Data Images and Verification/Correction

rows.source_ko: 5. 농업위성 활용산출물 생산ㆍ분석, 활용기술 개발 및 개선 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Production and Analysis of Agricultural Satellite Outputs, and Development and Improvement of Utilization Technologies

rows.source_ko: 6. 농업위성 활용산출물 품질관리 및 개선 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on Quality Management and Improvement of Agricultural Satellite Outputs

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업 관련 국내외 위성 관측자료 융합을 위한 데이터 수집ㆍ분석 및 농업적 활용 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on Data Collection, Analysis, and Agricultural Application for the Integration of Domestic and International Satellite Observation Data Related to Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 8. 농업 관련 국내외 위성 협력체계 구축 연구
rows.text_en: 8. Research on Establishing a Domestic and International Satellite Cooperation System Related to Agriculture

rows.source_ko: 9. 차세대 농업위성 등 후속 농업위성 개발 연구
rows.text_en: 9. Research on the development of subsequent agricultural satellites, including next-generation agricultural satellites

rows.source_ko: 10. 농업위성 관측망 구축ㆍ운영 및 정보의 수집ㆍ활용에 필요한 전문인력 양성
rows.text_en: 10. Training of specialized personnel required for the establishment and operation of agricultural satellite observation networks and the collection and utilization of information
⑧ Deleted <February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(농업생명자원부) ① 농업생명자원부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17., 2017. 11. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Ministry of Agriculture, Life Resources and Resources) ① The Minister of Agriculture, Life Resources and Resources shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, public health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011; Nov. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 농업생명자원부에 디지털육종지원과ㆍ생물안전성과 및 슈퍼컴퓨팅센터를 두며, 디지털육종지원과장은 농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 생물안전성과장은 농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 환경연구관으로, 슈퍼컴퓨팅센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 환경연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2013. 10. 1., 2015. 5. 26., 2015. 11. 30., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Ministry of Agriculture, Life Sciences and Resources shall have the Digital Breeding Support Division, the Biosafety Division, and the Supercomputing Center. The Head of the Digital Breeding Support Division shall be an Agricultural Research Officer or a Health Research Officer; the Head of the Biosafety Division shall be an Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, Health Research Officer, or Environmental Research Officer; and the Head of the Supercomputing Center shall be a Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Agricultural Research Officer, Health Research Officer, or Environmental Research Officer. <Amended June 1, 2012; October 1, 2013; May 26, 2015; November 30, 2015; July 1, 2021; August 30, 2023; February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 디지털육종지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Digital Breeding Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 작물의 유전체 구조ㆍ기능 분석 및 유전자 대량 발굴ㆍ활용 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of technologies for the analysis of crop genome structure and function, and for the mass discovery and utilization of genes

rows.source_ko: 2. 기후변화 대응 환경스트레스 내성 및 병해충 방어 증진 유전자 개발
rows.text_en: 2. Development of genes to enhance environmental stress tolerance and pest and disease defense in response to climate change

rows.source_ko: 3. 유전체, 표현체 등 분석정보의 생산, 축적, 분석 및 활용 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the production, accumulation, analysis, and utilization of analytical information such as genomes and phenotypes

rows.source_ko: 4. 빅데이터, 인공지능 기반 디지털육종 기술 개발 및 제공ㆍ활용
rows.text_en: 4. Development, provision, and utilization of big data and AI-based digital breeding technologies

rows.source_ko: 5. 작물 형질전환 시스템 구축 및 식물체 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment of crop transformation system and development of plants

rows.source_ko: 6. 생명공학작물 소재 육성 및 활용기술 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of breeding and utilization technologies for biotech crop materials

rows.source_ko: ④ 생물안전성과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Biosafety Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 바이오 신작물의 환경 및 식품 안전성 평가 기반기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of Basic Technologies for Environmental and Food Safety Assessment of New Biocrops

rows.source_ko: 2. 바이오 신작물의 안전성 증진 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Enhancing the Safety of New Bio-crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 유전자변형 바이오 신작물의 검정 및 모니터링 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Testing and Monitoring Technologies for Genetically Modified Biocrops

rows.source_ko: 4. 바이오 신작물 연구ㆍ개발의 안전관리 기반기술 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Basic Technologies for Safety Management in Research and Development of New Biocrops

rows.source_ko: 5. 생물안전성 정보 관리 및 쟁점대응 기술적 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Technical support for biosafety information management and issue response

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 슈퍼컴퓨팅센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director of the Supercomputing Center shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농생명 분야 빅데이터 수집ㆍ관리
rows.text_en: 1. Collection and Management of Big Data in the Agri-Life Sciences Sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 농생명 분야 빅데이터 통합ㆍ분석ㆍ활용 지원
rows.text_en: 2. Support for Big Data Integration, Analysis, and Utilization in the Agri-Life Sciences Sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 슈퍼컴퓨터 활용 분석 및 지원 환경 구축
rows.text_en: 3. Establishment of Supercomputer-based Analysis and Support Environment

rows.source_ko: 4. 초고성능컴퓨터 운영ㆍ관리, 대국민 공동활용 지원 및 정보서비스 운영ㆍ고도화
rows.text_en: 4. Operation and management of supercomputers, support for public shared use, and operation and advancement of information services
⑥ Deleted <February 25, 2025>
Article 17 Deleted <February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(농업유전자원센터) ① 농업유전자원센터장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관 또는 농업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Agricultural Genetic Resources Center) ① The Director of the Agricultural Genetic Resources Center shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, or Agricultural Research Officers. <Amended Jun. 1, 2012; Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 농업유전자원센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2015. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Agricultural Genetic Resources Center shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Jun. 1, 2012; Jan. 6, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 농업유전자원 관리체계 구축을 위한 기본계획의 수립
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment of a basic plan for the construction of an agricultural genetic resource management system

rows.source_ko: 2. 농업유전자원의 수집ㆍ분류ㆍ보존ㆍ증식ㆍ분양 및 특성평가
rows.text_en: 2. Collection, classification, preservation, propagation, distribution, and characterization of agricultural genetic resources

rows.source_ko: 3. 농업유전자원의 이용에 대한 기술개발 및 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Technology development and research on the utilization of agricultural genetic resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 농업유전자원 종합 정보관리
rows.text_en: 4. Comprehensive Information Management of Agricultural Genetic Resources

rows.source_ko: 5. 농업유전자원의 중복 보존 관리 및 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Management and Research of Duplicate Conservation of Agricultural Genetic Resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 농업유전자원에 관한 국제교류 및 협력
rows.text_en: 6. International Exchange and Cooperation on Agricultural Genetic Resources

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업유전자원의 보존ㆍ관리ㆍ이용과 관련된 전문인력 육성
rows.text_en: 7. Fostering specialized personnel related to the conservation, management, and utilization of agricultural genetic resources

rows.source_ko: 제4장 국립식량과학원
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 National Institute of Crop and Food Science

rows.source_ko: 제19조(원장) 국립식량과학원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2011. 2. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Director) The Director of the National Institute of Crop and Food Science shall be appointed from among general civil servants, agricultural research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Feb. 17, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(국립식량과학원) ① 국립식량과학원에 기획조정과ㆍ운영지원과 및 기술지원과를 두며, 기획조정과장ㆍ운영지원과장 및 기술지원과장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2015. 1. 6., 2015. 11. 30., 2018. 9. 4., 2020. 3. 31., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (National Institute of Crop and Food Science) ① The National Institute of Crop and Food Science shall have a Planning and Coordination Division, an Operations Support Division, and a Technology Support Division; the Heads of the Planning and Coordination Division, the Operations Support Division, and the Technology Support Division shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Agricultural Research Officers, or Rural Extension Officers. <Amended Jan. 6, 2015; Nov. 30, 2015; Sep. 4, 2018; Mar. 31, 2020; July 1, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시험연구사업에 관한 계획의 수립ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and evaluation of plans for test and research projects

rows.source_ko: 2. 시험연구사업 관리
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Test and Research Projects

rows.source_ko: 3. 예산의 편성 및 집행의 조정
rows.text_en: 3. Coordination of budget formulation and execution

rows.source_ko: 4. 성과관리 및 직무성과계약 제도 운영
rows.text_en: 4. Operation of Performance Management and Job Performance Contract Systems

rows.source_ko: 5. 국제협력 연구 등 대외협력업무의 기획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Planning and coordination of external cooperation affairs, including international cooperation research

rows.source_ko: 6. 연구성과 및 기관 홍보계획ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Research Achievements and Institutional Promotion Plan and Coordination

rows.source_ko: 7. 정보화 사업 총괄 및 전산실 운영
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of IT projects and operation of the computer center

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 원내 다른 부 및 과의 주관에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments and divisions within the Institute

rows.source_ko: ③ 운영지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of Operations Support Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인사ㆍ문서ㆍ보안 및 관인관수
rows.text_en: 1. Personnel, Documents, Security, and Management of Official Seals

rows.source_ko: 2. 훈령ㆍ예규ㆍ지침안의 입안
rows.text_en: 2. Drafting of Directives, Circulars, and Guidelines

rows.source_ko: 3. 급여ㆍ회계ㆍ결산 및 용도
rows.text_en: 3. Payroll, Accounting, Settlement, and Usage

rows.source_ko: 4. 국유재산 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of state-owned property and goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 연구개발ㆍ보급에 관한 행정지원
rows.text_en: 5. Other administrative support regarding research and development and dissemination

rows.source_ko: ④ 기술지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Technical Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신품종ㆍ신기술의 농가실증 및 시범사업
rows.text_en: 1. Farm demonstration and pilot projects for new varieties and technologies

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물 우량종자 생산 및 조기 보급
rows.text_en: 2. Production and early distribution of high-quality seeds for food crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 현장애로기술 발굴 및 연구사업화 추진
rows.text_en: 3. Identification of on-site technical challenges and promotion of research commercialization

rows.source_ko: 4. 식량작물의 기술개발 및 보급 일관화 시스템 구축ㆍ지원
rows.text_en: 4. Establishment and support of an integrated system for the technology development and dissemination of food crops

rows.source_ko: 5. 작물분야 개발기술 산업화 지원
rows.text_en: 5. Support for the industrialization of developed technologies in the crop sector

rows.source_ko: 제21조(기초식량작물부) ① 기초식량작물부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Ministry of Basic Food Crops) ① The Head of the Ministry of Basic Food Crops shall be appointed from among general civil servants, agricultural researchers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기초식량작물부에 품종개발과ㆍ재배생리과ㆍ작물환경과ㆍ맥류작물과ㆍ중북부작물연구센터 및 간척지농업연구센터를 두며, 품종개발과장ㆍ재배생리과장 및 중북부작물연구센터장은 농업연구관으로, 작물환경과장 및 맥류작물과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 간척지농업연구센터장은 농업연구관 또는 환경연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2026. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Basic Food Crops shall have the Variety Development Division, Cultivation Physiology Division, Crop Environment Division, Cereal Crops Division, Central and Northern Crop Research Center, and Reclaimed Land Agriculture Research Center; the heads of the Variety Development Division, Cultivation Physiology Division, and Central and Northern Crop Research Center shall be appointed as Agricultural Research Officers; the heads of the Crop Environment Division and Cereal Crops Division shall be appointed as Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Agricultural Research Officer, Environmental Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer; and the head of the Reclaimed Land Agriculture Research Center shall be appointed as an Agricultural Research Officer or Environmental Research Officer. <Amended May 28, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 품종개발과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of Variety Development is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식량작물(맥류는 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 품종개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on variety development of food crops (excluding cereals; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물의 주요 형질(形質)이 다음 세대에 유전되는 상태(狀態)에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. A Study on the Status of Major Traits of Food Crops Inherited to the Next Generation

rows.source_ko: 3. 식량작물 육종의 효율 증진기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Technology to Enhance the Efficiency of Food Crop Breeding

rows.source_ko: 4. 식량작물의 유전자원 수집 및 유용한 유전자의 탐색ㆍ해석ㆍ발굴 등에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the collection of genetic resources of food crops and the search, interpretation, and discovery of useful genes

rows.source_ko: 5. 벼 유전체 및 표현체 기반 육종 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Rice Genome and Phenotype-Based Breeding Research

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 부 내 다른 과 또는 센터의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions or centers within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 재배생리과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of Cultivation Physiology is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식량작물(맥류는 제외한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)의 생리 및 생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the physiology and ecology of food crops (excluding cereals; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물의 재배기술 개발
rows.text_en: 2. Development of cultivation techniques for food crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 벼의 작황 조사 및 예측에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Rice Crop Survey and Forecasting

rows.source_ko: 4. 기후변화에 따른 식량작물의 기후영향평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Climate Impact Assessment of Food Crops Due to Climate Change

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 작물환경과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Crop Environment Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식량작물의 병해충 관리 등 작물 보호에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on crop protection, including pest and disease management of food crops

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물의 신규 유입 병해충의 진단 및 방제에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Diagnosis and Control of Newly Introduced Pests and Diseases of Food Crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 식량작물의 생산환경 개선에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Improvement of Food Crops Production Environments

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 맥류작물과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Cereal Crops Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 맥류의 품종 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the development of cereal varieties

rows.source_ko: 2. 맥류의 주요 형질이 다음 세대에 유전되는 상태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. A study on the inheritance of major traits of cereals to the next generation

rows.source_ko: 3. 맥류 육종의 효율 증진기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Technology to Enhance Efficiency in Cereal Breeding

rows.source_ko: 4. 맥류의 유전자원 수집 및 유용한 유전자의 탐색ㆍ해석ㆍ발굴 등에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the collection of genetic resources of cereals and the search, analysis, and discovery of useful genes

rows.source_ko: 5. 맥류의 생리 및 생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the physiology and ecology of cereals

rows.source_ko: 6. 맥류의 재배기술 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of Cultivation Techniques for Barley

rows.source_ko: 7. 맥류의 작황 조사 및 예측에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on Crop Survey and Forecasting of Cereals

rows.source_ko: 8. 맥류의 용도별 품질평가 및 기준설정에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 8. A Study on Quality Evaluation and Standard Setting for Barley by Use

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 중북부작물연구센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Director of the Central and Northern Crop Research Center is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 중북부기후대 적응 식량작물ㆍ사료작물ㆍ풋거름작물의 품종개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the Development of Varietyes of Food Crops, Forage Crops, and Green Manure Crops Adapted to the Central and Northern Climate Zone

rows.source_ko: 2. 중북부기후대 적응 식량작물ㆍ사료작물ㆍ풋거름작물의 유전자원 수집ㆍ이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Collection and Utilization of Genetic Resources of Food Crops, Forage Crops, and Green Manure Crops Adapted to the Central and Northern Climate Zone

rows.source_ko: 3. 중북부기후대 적응 식량작물ㆍ사료작물ㆍ풋거름작물의 재배기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of cultivation techniques for food crops, fodder crops, and green manure crops adapted to the central and northern climate zones

rows.source_ko: 4. 풋거름작물 이용 등 중북부기후대 지력 증진 및 저투입(低投入) 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Soil Fertility Enhancement and Low-Input Technologies in the Central and Northern Climate Zones, Including the Use of Green Manure Crops

rows.source_ko: 5. 식량작물의 북방농업지대 환경 적응성 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Study on the Environmental Adaptability of Food Crops to Northern Agricultural Zones

rows.source_ko: 6. 중부지역 식량작물 작황 조사 및 예측에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Study on the Survey and Forecast of Food Crop Conditions in the Central Region

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 간척지농업연구센터장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Director of the Reclaimed Land Agriculture Research Center is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 간척지에 적합한 작물 및 재배기술의 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of crops and cultivation techniques suitable for reclaimed land

rows.source_ko: 2. 간척지 농업환경에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Agricultural Environment of Reclaimed Land

rows.source_ko: 3. 친환경ㆍ첨단 농업단지 조성 등 간척지 이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Use of Reclaimed Land, Including the Creation of Eco-friendly and High-tech Agricultural Complexes
[Wholly Amended Feb. 25, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(밭작물개발부) ① 밭작물개발부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ농업연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Field Crop Development Department) ① The Head of the Field Crop Development Department shall be appointed from among general civil servants, agricultural research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 밭작물개발부에 밭작물개발과ㆍ경지이용작물과 및 스마트생산기술과를 두며, 밭작물개발과장 및 경지이용작물과장은 농업연구관으로, 스마트생산기술과장은 공업연구관 또는 농업연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Field Crop Development Department shall have the Field Crop Development Division, the Land Utilization Crops Division, and the Smart Production Technology Division; the Heads of the Field Crop Development Division and the Land Utilization Crops Division shall be appointed as Agricultural Research Officers, and the Head of the Smart Production Technology Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Research Officer or an Agricultural Research Officer. <Amended July 1, 2021; February 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 밭작물개발과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Field Crop Development Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 두류의 품종개발과 유전자원의 수집ㆍ이용 및 평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the development of legume varieties and the collection, use, and evaluation of genetic resources

rows.source_ko: 2. 유지작물의 품종개발과 유전자원의 수집ㆍ이용 및 평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on variety development of oilseed crops and the collection, use, and evaluation of genetic resources

rows.source_ko: 3. 잡곡류의 품종개발과 유전자원의 수집ㆍ이용 및 평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Variety Development of Coarse Grains and Collection, Utilization, and Evaluation of Genetic Resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 밭작물개발부의 행정지원 업무
rows.text_en: 4. Administrative support duties of the Field Crop Development Department

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 부내 다른 과에 속하지 아니하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters not belonging to other divisions within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 경지이용작물과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2018. 9. 4., 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Land Use Crops Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Sep. 4, 2018; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 남부지역 다모작지 적응 단기성, 초다수성(超多收性) 및 기능성 벼 품종개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of short-harvesting, super-high-yielding, and functional rice varieties adapted to multi-cropping areas in the southern region
2. Deleted <September 4, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 3. 남부지역 다모작지 벼의 재배기술 개발 및 작황 조사
rows.text_en: 3. Development of Rice Cultivation Techniques and Crop Condition Survey for Multi-cropping Rice in the Southern Region

rows.source_ko: 4. 논이용 작물의 생태반응에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. A Study on the Ecological Responses of Crops Used in Paddy Fields

rows.source_ko: 5. 논이용 작물의 생태환경별 경지 이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. A Study on Land Use by Ecological Environment of Crops in Paddy Fields

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 스마트생산기술과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Smart Production Technology Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 두류ㆍ유지작물ㆍ잡곡류 등 밭작물의 재배기술 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of cultivation techniques for field crops such as legumes, oilseeds, and miscellaneous grains

rows.source_ko: 2. 두류ㆍ유지작물ㆍ잡곡류 작황 조사 및 예측에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Crop Survey and Forecasting of Legumes, Oilseed Crops, and Miscellaneous Grains

rows.source_ko: 3. 밭작물의 재해[습해, 한해(旱害)] 경감 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 3. Development of technologies to mitigate damage to field crops [waterlogging, drought]

rows.source_ko: 4. 식량작물의 친환경 생산관리기술 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Eco-friendly Production Management Technologies for Food Crops

rows.source_ko: 5. 남부지역 식량작물의 병해충 방제기술 개발
rows.text_en: 5. Development of Pest and Disease Control Technologies for Food Crops in the Southern Region

rows.source_ko: 6. 밭작물 노지 스마트농업 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 6. Development of Open-Field Smart Agriculture Technology for Field Crops

[Wholly Amended Jan. 6, 2015]
[Title Amended Feb. 25, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제22조의2(식품자원개발부) ① 식품자원개발부장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원ㆍ공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관ㆍ보건연구관ㆍ환경연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22-2 (Ministry of Food Resource Development) ① The Minister of Food Resource Development shall be appointed from among general civil servants, industrial research officers, agricultural research officers, veterinary research officers, health research officers, environmental research officers, or rural extension officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of such position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 식품자원개발부에 식생활영양과ㆍ발효가공식품과ㆍ푸드테크소재과 및 품질관리평가과를 두며, 식생활영양과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 발효가공식품과장은 농업연구관ㆍ보건연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로, 푸드테크소재과장은 공업연구관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 보건연구관으로, 품질관리평가과장은 농업연구관으로 보한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Department of Food Resource Development shall have the Dietary Nutrition Division, the Fermented Processed Foods Division, the Food Tech Materials Division, and the Quality Control Evaluation Division. The head of the Dietary Nutrition Division shall be appointed as a Science and Technology Secretary, Agricultural Research Officer, Health Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer; the head of the Fermented Processed Foods Division shall be appointed as an Agricultural Research Officer, Health Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer; the head of the Food Tech Materials Division shall be appointed as an Industrial Research Officer, Agricultural Research Officer, or Health Research Officer; and the head of the Quality Control Evaluation Division shall be appointed as an Agricultural Research Officer.

rows.source_ko: ③ 식생활영양과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Dietary and Nutrition Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식문화자원의 산업화 지원에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on Support for the Industrialization of Food Culture Resources

rows.source_ko: 2. 한식의 영양 및 건강기능성 등에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Nutritional and Health Functional Properties of Korean Food

rows.source_ko: 3. 전통음식의 발굴 및 계승발전에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Discovery, Succession, and Development of Traditional Foods

rows.source_ko: 4. 영양기능성분 데이터 구축 및 국가식품성분표 개발 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Establishment of Nutritional Functional Component Data and the Development and Utilization of the National Food Composition Table

rows.source_ko: 5. 지속가능한 식생활에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Sustainable Dietary Habits

rows.source_ko: 6. 농식품자원의 수요자 기반 소비 확대 및 정책지원연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on Expanding Consumer-Based Consumption of Agri-food Resources and Policy Support

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 부 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other divisions within the department

rows.source_ko: ④ 발효가공식품과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Fermented Processed Food Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 발효 미생물ㆍ원료 및 기반ㆍ응용기술 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the development of fermentation microorganisms, raw materials, and basic and applied technologies

rows.source_ko: 2. 발효식품 품질관리 및 상품성 향상에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on Quality Control and Marketability Improvement of Fermented Foods

rows.source_ko: 3. 농산자원을 활용한 발효식품 소재 개발 및 정보화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Development and Informatization of Fermented Food Materials Utilizing Agricultural Resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 천연발효 첨가물 개발 및 이용기술 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development and Utilization Technology of Naturally Fermented Additives

rows.source_ko: 5. 지역특산 농식품자원의 활용성 증진에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on Enhancing the Utilization of Local Specialty Agri-food Resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 농산물 가공기술의 실용화 등 부가가치 증진에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the enhancement of added value, such as the practical application of agricultural product processing technology

rows.source_ko: 7. 농산자원의 식품가공 소재화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 7. Research on the Utilization of Agricultural Resources as Food Processing Materials

rows.source_ko: 8. 전통주 등의 과학화 및 산업화 지원에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 8. Research on Support for the Scientific Advancement and Industrialization of Traditional Alcoholic Beverages, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 푸드테크소재과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Food Tech Materials Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 푸드테크 접목 미래 식품 소재 개발 및 데이터 구축 기반 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on the development of future food materials incorporating food technology and the establishment of a data foundation

rows.source_ko: 2. 농식품자원의 유용성분 구조해석, 생리활성 평가, 대사생리 및 작용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the structural analysis, physiological activity evaluation, metabolic physiology, and action of useful components of agricultural and food resources

rows.source_ko: 3. 농식품자원의 푸드테크 소재화를 위한 원료 표준화 및 안전성에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on Raw Material Standardization and Safety for the Food Tech Application of Agri-food Resources

rows.source_ko: 4. 농식품자원을 이용한 기능성 원료ㆍ소재 및 기능성 식품 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on the Development of Functional Raw Materials, Materials, and Functional Foods Using Agri-food Resources

rows.source_ko: 5. 농산부산물의 활용 기술 개발 및 자원순환에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Development of Utilization Technologies for Agricultural By-products and Resource Circulation

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 품질관리평가과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Quality Control Evaluation Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 식량작물 등의 용도별 품질 및 감각평가에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 1. A Study on the Quality and Sensory Evaluation of Food Crops, etc. by Use

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물 등의 수확 후 건조, 저장 등 스마트 품질 제어기술 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Development of Smart Quality Control Technologies for Post-Harvest Drying, Storage, etc. of Food Crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 식량작물 등의 포장ㆍ유통기술 개발에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the development of packaging and distribution technologies for food crops, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 식량작물 등 기후변화 대응 품질ㆍ안정성 평가 및 증진 기술 개발
rows.text_en: 4. Development of Quality and Safety Assessment and Enhancement Technologies for Food Crops and Others in Response to Climate Change

rows.source_ko: 5. 농식품자원의 표준화 및 규격화에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 5. Research on the Standardization and Specification of Agri-food Resources

rows.source_ko: 6. 식량작물 등의 품질표현정보 축적 및 활용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 6. Research on the Accumulation and Utilization of Quality Expression Information for Food Crops, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 25, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(고령지농업연구소) ① 고령지농업연구소장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관 또는 환경연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1., 2015. 1. 6., 2021. 7. 1., 2026. 5. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Highland Agriculture Research Institute) ① The Director of the Highland Agriculture Research Institute shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Agricultural Research Officer, or Environmental Research Officer. <Amended June 1, 2012; Jan. 6, 2015; July 1, 2021; May 28, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 고령지농업연구소장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2009. 9. 1., 2012. 6. 1., 2015. 1. 6.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the Highland Agriculture Research Institute shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Sep. 1, 2009; Jun. 1, 2012; Jan. 6, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 감자의 품종개량 및 재배법 개선 연구

rows.text_en: Article 24 (Institute of Income Food Crops) ① The Director of the Institute of Income Food Crops shall be appointed from among the Senior Secretary for Science and Technology, Senior Secretary, Industrial Research Officer, or Agricultural Research Officer. <Amended June 1, 2012; Jan. 6, 2015; July 1, 2021; Aug. 30, 2023; Feb. 25, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고구마 등 바이오에너지작물, 아열대식량작물 및 남부지방 소득작물의 품종개량 및 재배법 개선 연구
rows.text_en: 1. Research on variety improvement and cultivation method enhancement for bioenergy crops such as sweet potatoes, subtropical food crops, and income crops in the southern region

rows.source_ko: 2. 바이오에너지작물, 아열대식량작물 및 남부지방 소득작물의 유전자원 수집ㆍ보존ㆍ평가 및 생명공학 실용화 연구

rows.source_ko: 3. 바이오에너지작물, 아열대식량작물 및 남부지방 소득작물의 생리생태 및 재해경감기술 연구
rows.text_en: 3. Research on the Physiological Ecology and Disaster Mitigation Technologies of Bioenergy Crops, Subtropical Food Crops, and Southern Income Crops

rows.source_ko: 4. 바이오에너지작물, 아열대식량작물 및 남부지방 소득작물의 산업소재화 기술 및 수확 후 관리ㆍ이용에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 4. Research on Industrialization Technology and Post-Harvest Management and Utilization of Bioenergy Crops, Subtropical Food Crops, and Southern Income Crops

rows.source_ko: 제25조(출장소) ① 국립식량과학원에 두는 각 출장소의 명칭과 위치는 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Branch Offices) ① The names and locations of each branch office established within the National Institute of Crop and Food Scienceare as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.text_en: ② The head of each branch office shall be appointed as an Agricultural Research Officer. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③ 각 출장소장은 국립식량과학원장의 명을 받아 소관사무를 관장하며, 소속공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Each branch office head shall manage affairs under their jurisdiction upon receiving orders from the Director of the National Institute of Crop and Food Science, and shall direct and supervise officials under their jurisdiction.

rows.source_ko: ④ 춘천출장소는 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Chuncheon Branch Office shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 1, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 1. 벼 내냉성의 검정에 관한 시험ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 1. Tests and Research on the Verification of Cold Tolerance in Rice

rows.source_ko: 2. 식량작물 내냉성의 생리ㆍ생태에 관한 연구
rows.text_en: 2. Research on the Physiology and Ecology of Cold Tolerance in Food Crops

rows.source_ko: 3. 벼 내냉성의 계통육성을 위한 국제공동시험
rows.text_en: 3. International joint trial for breeding cold-tolerant rice lines

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 철원출장소는 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중북부지방의 중간지대에 적응하는 벼 조생종의 품종개발 및 재배기술의 체계 확립
rows.text_en: 1. Development of early-maturing rice varieties adapted to the intermediate zones of the central and northern regions and establishment of a systematic cultivation technique

rows.source_ko: 2. 북부지방에 적응하는 식량작물 품종 및 재배기술의 연구ㆍ개발
rows.text_en: 2. Research and development of food crop varieties and cultivation techniques adapted to northern regions

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영덕출장소는 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Yeongdeok Branch Office shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 1, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동해안 냉조풍지대에 적응하는 벼 신품종의 개발
rows.text_en: 1. Development of new rice varieties adapted to the cold wind zone of the East Coast

rows.source_ko: 2. 동해안 냉조풍지대에서의 식량작물 재배기술에 관한 시험 및 개선
rows.text_en: 2. Testing and Improvement of Food Crop Cultivation Techniques in the Cold Tidal Wind Zone of the East Coast

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 상주출장소는 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2012. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Sangju Branch Office shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended June 1, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중산간 고냉지대에 적응하는 벼의 신품종 개발

rows.source_ko: 2. 중산간 고냉지대에서의 식량작물 재배기술에 관한 시험 및 개선
rows.text_en: 2. Testing and improvement of food crop cultivation techniques in mid-mountainous high-altitude regions

rows.text_en: Chapter 4-2 Rural Human Resources Development Center <Newly established Feb. 26, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제25조의2(농촌인적자원개발센터) ① 농촌인적자원개발센터장은 부이사관ㆍ과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 25-2 (Rural Human Resources Development Center) ① The Director of a Rural Human Resources Development Center shall be appointed from among Deputy Directors, Secretary of Science and Technology, Secretary, Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officers. <Amended July 1, 2021; August 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 농촌인적자원개발센터에 교육훈련기획과 및 역량개발과를 두되, 각 과장은 과학기술서기관ㆍ서기관ㆍ농업사무관ㆍ행정사무관ㆍ농업연구관ㆍ수의연구관 또는 농촌지도관으로 보한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 8. 30., 2023. 12. 19., 2026. 2. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The Rural Human Resources Development Center shall establish an Education and Training Planning Division and a Competency Development Division; the heads of each division shall be appointed from among Science and Technology Secretary, Secretary, Agricultural Officer, Administrative Officer, Agricultural Research Officer, Veterinary Research Officer, or Rural Extension Officer. <Amended July 1, 2021; August 30, 2023; December 19, 2023; February 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 교육훈련기획과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Education and Training Planning Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인사ㆍ문서ㆍ보안ㆍ관인 및 관인대장의 관리
rows.text_en: 1. Management of personnel, documents, security, official seals, and the official seal register

rows.source_ko: 2. 훈령ㆍ예규ㆍ지침안의 입안
rows.text_en: 2. Drafting of Directives, Circulars, and Guidelines

rows.source_ko: 3. 급여ㆍ회계ㆍ결산 및 용도
rows.text_en: 3. Payroll, Accounting, Settlement, and Usage

rows.source_ko: 4. 국유재산 및 물품의 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Management of state-owned property and goods

rows.source_ko: 5. 중장기 및 연도별 교육훈련 계획의 수립ㆍ평가 및 평가결과에 대한 포상
rows.text_en: 5. Establishment and evaluation of mid-to-long-term and annual education and training plans, and awards for evaluation results

rows.source_ko: 6. 교육훈련 수요조사 및 교육과정 설계ㆍ연구개발
rows.text_en: 6. Education and Training Needs Survey and Curriculum Design and Research and Development

rows.source_ko: 7. 교육훈련 정보화시스템 구축ㆍ운영
rows.text_en: 7. Establishment and Operation of Education and Training Information Systems

rows.source_ko: 8. 지방농촌진흥기관 등과의 교육훈련 분야 대내외 협력
rows.text_en: 8. Internal and external cooperation in the field of education and training with local rural development agencies, etc.

rows.source_ko: 9. 그 밖에 센터내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Center

rows.source_ko: ④ 역량개발과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Competency Development Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Dec. 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공무원에 대한 직무교육 과정의 운영ㆍ평가

rows.source_ko: 2. 농업인 등에 대한 교육훈련 과정의 운영ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 2. Operation and evaluation of education and training courses for farmers, etc.
3. Deleted <December 19, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 4. 교육훈련 분야 국고보조사업 운영 및 관리 지원
rows.text_en: 4. Support for the operation and management of government-subsidized projects in the education and training sector

rows.source_ko: 5. 교육훈련 과정에 대한 교재의 편찬ㆍ발간
rows.text_en: 5. Compilation and publication of textbooks for education and training courses

rows.source_ko: 6. 농업기계 취급ㆍ조작 및 안전교육 과정의 운영ㆍ평가
rows.text_en: 6. Operation and Evaluation of Agricultural Machinery Handling, Operation, and Safety Education Courses

rows.source_ko: 7. 농업기계 교육훈련 시설ㆍ장비의 운영 및 관리

rows.source_ko: 제5장 국립원예특작과학원
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 National Institute of Horticultural and Herbal Science

rows.source_ko: 제26조(원장) ① 국립원예특작과학원에 원장 1명을 두고, 원장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 임기제공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2013. 12. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Director) ① The National Institute of Horticultural and Herbal Science shall have one Director. The Director shall be appointed as a fixed-term public official belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Dec. 12, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 원장은 국립원예특작과학원의 사무를 총괄하고, 소속공무원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다. <개정 2019. 2. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director shall oversee the affairs of the National Institute of Horticultural and Herbal Science and direct and supervise its officials. <Amended Feb. 26, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제27조(고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위의 수 등) 국립원예특작과학원에 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위 3개(제26조제1항의 고위공무원단 직위를 포함한다)를 두고, 제26조제1항의 고위공무원단 직위를 제외한 고위공무원단에 속하는 공무원으로 보하는 직위의 직무등급은 「책임운영기관의 설치ㆍ운영에 관한 법률」 제10조에 따른 기본운영규정에 표시한다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Number of positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, etc.) The National Institute of Horticultural and Herbal Science shall have three positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service (including the Senior Civil Service positions under Article 26 , Paragraph 1 ) , and the job grades of the positions to be filled by public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, excluding the Senior Civil Service positions under Article 26, Paragraph, shall be indicated in the basic operating regulations pursuant to Article 10 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Responsible Management Agencies .

rows.source_ko: 제28조(연구소) 국립원예특작과학원장 소속으로 온난화대응농업연구소ㆍ시설원예연구소를 두고, 각 연구소에 소장 1명을 두되, 소장은 4급 또는 연구관으로 보한다. <개정 2016. 5. 10., 2022. 2. 22., 2023. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Research Institutes) The Climate Change Response Agriculture Research Institute and the Greenhouse Horticulture Research Institute shall be established under the jurisdiction of the Director of the National Institute of Horticultural and Herbal Science. Each research institute shall have one Director, who shall be appointed at the Grade 4 level or as a Research Officer. <Amended May 10, 2016; Feb. 22, 2022; Dec. 19, 2023>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 6, 2015]
Article 29 Deleted <January 6, 2015>
Article 30 Deleted <February 25, 2025>
